answer: A bond of 21% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in delta, and pigment reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 82 aliases, and each one needs its own funded plume account. Each duplicate costs another 70 dollars in locked collateral and another 2 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
